fullContent:
Vizhal Veradi Kashayam 
 Reference: Sahasra Yogam. 
 Vizhal Veradi Kashayam is classical Ayurvedic formulation used for the treatment of obesity and gulma. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Triphala ( Emblica officinale, Terminalia chebula and Terminalia bellerica ) 
 Chitraka ( Plumbago zeylanica ) 
 Lohapatra (Iron) 
 Haridra ( Curcuma longa ) 
 Water 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 All the above mentioned ingredients are added with 8 parts of water. It is boiled until reduced to quarter part to make the Vizhal Veradi Kashayam. 
 Dosage 
 Take 5 ml of Kashaya is to be mixed with 5 ml of lukewarm water and mixed well and taken in empty stomach two times a day. 
 Indications 
 
 Obesity 
 Gulma 
 Headaches 
 Injuries 
 Wounds 
 Bloating 
 Abscess 
 Edema 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
